title: Ecosystem Study
subtitle: An industry veteran working on the front lines in Arizona shared the framework he uses to understand industrial ecosystems.
html:
Framework source: Executive Director, Arizona Trade & Investment Office - Taiwan Steve Hsu (徐竹先) ↗

Why it matters:

This framework helped me look at the connections between businesses and understand how policy, infrastructure, supply chains and professional services support one another to turn investment into local operations—and what it takes for an industry cluster to develop.

I am grateful for the insights he has built through hands-on experience. They have helped me broaden my perspective from individual companies to the ecosystem as a whole.
